subject: Player name
text: Player names starting with DA prevent main achievements from unlocking.

evidence.quote: Don't try any name starting with DA or no main achievements will unlock.

subject: ROM version
text: The achievements require the US ROM version.

evidence.quote: and it is a US Rom

subject: Accounts
text: Creating more than one account stops most achievements from unlocking.

evidence.quote: also create no more then 1 account. Otherwise most achievements will not unlock.

subject: Blocking shots
text: Blocking a shot is much harder in NBA Jam than in Jam TE.

evidence.quote: It is much harder to block a shot in this game than in Jam TE.

subject: Save system
text: NBA Jam does not save progress like Jam TE, so records are lost on exit unless the password is kept or save states are used.

evidence.quote: this game does not save your progress like Jam TE. Your record will be lost when you exit the game if you don't keep track of the password (unless you use save states).

subject: Warning achievement
text: The Warning achievement does not trigger in RetroArch and requires one of the emulators on the site.

evidence.quote: The warning doesn't trigger with retroarch. ... You have to use one of the emulators on the site.

subject: CPU
text: The CPU cheats on one side, but the player can exploit its deterministic weaknesses.

evidence.quote: Playing mechanically symmetrial action games (fighting, sports, etc) against the AI always seems to turn into an exercise in the AI flagrantly cheating on one side and the player exploiting the AI's deterministic weaknesses on the other.

subject: CPU
text: On the hardest difficulty, the CPU throwing three-pointers from midcourt was the worst part.

evidence.quote: Hardest and the CPU throwing 3pts at mid court was the worst but fun set xD

subject: CPU full court shots
text: On V. Hard, CPU full court shots always go in, causing losses at the last second.

evidence.quote: I have headaches losing last second because the full court shots ALWAYS GO IN.

subject: Mastery of NBA
object: Power-Up Fire and computer assistance off
text: The 200-point achievement is the toughest; it requires turning on Power-Up Fire and turning off computer assistance.

evidence.quote: The 200 points was the toughest achievement, although it took me a little bit to realize I could turn on Power-Up Fire (you're on fire the whole game no matter what) and turn off computer assistance.

subject: Game clock
text: The game clock can be set to very fast to make games go quicker.

evidence.quote: I turned the clock up to very fast to make the games go quicker.

subject: Juice mode
text: Juice mode can be turned on to make possessions go quicker.

evidence.quote: I also did this achievement after I beat each team, so juice mode was on to help the possessions go even quicker.

subject: Rubber banding
text: With a 3+ point lead in the 4th quarter and the ball, wait at half court until the shot clock reaches about 7 seconds, then drive toward the basket and weave up or down to get past the defender.

evidence.quote: Once you build roughly a 3+ point lead in the 4th quarter and have the ball, stand at half court and wait for the shotclock to appear to give the other team fewer possessions. ... Once it gets down to about 7 seconds left, drive toward the basket and weave up or down and you'll blow by the defender nearly every time as the defender runs in a straight line at your initial position.

subject: CPU teammate
text: Standing at half court to have the CPU teammate run into your defender pushes the defender over, freeing a run to the basket; the guarding defender only acts after you cross half court.

evidence.quote: Alternatively, you can stand at half court and try to get your CPU teammate to run toward the defender guarding you and your CPU will push him over so you have a free run to the basket. ... The defender guarding you won't do a thing unless you cross halfcourt first.

subject: Jump pass
text: After the CPU teammate inbounds to you, start a shot, hold the shoot button as both defenders jump, then pass in the air to your CPU teammate.

evidence.quote: When your teammate CPU inbounds the ball to you, immediately start to shoot the ball, but hold the shoot button as both defenders jump at you, and then pass the ball while in the air to your CPU teammate.

subject: CPU teammate
text: After the pass, the CPU teammate usually goes straight to the basket, or can shoot a three while you chase the rebound.

evidence.quote: Most of the time, the CPU will just go straight to the basket, or you can have him shoot from 3 and you can outrun the defenders who jumped anyways to get a rebound just incase.

subject: 200-point challenge
text: For the 200-point challenge, set the computer to normal difficulty and slow time.

evidence.quote: For the 200 pt challenge I set the computer to normal difficulty and slow time.

subject: 200-point challenge
text: Setting the computer to very easy caused missed dunks and long rebounds that lost time.

evidence.quote: I had a few attempts changing the computer to very easy difficulty, but they kept missing dunks that would doink off the rim. ... This kept creating long rebound situations and losing time.

subject: Constant on fire code
text: At the matchup screen, press B seven times, then hold B+Y+UP until tip off to activate constant on fire.

evidence.quote: Also make sure to activate the constant on fire code. At the matchup screen press B seven times then hold down B+Y+UP until tip off.

subject: Very hard team choice
text: On very hard, playing mostly as the Hornets, with some games as the Bulls, worked best because of their power forward/center combos.

evidence.quote: Playing mostly as the Hornets and some games as the Bulls. These are two teams with power forward/center combos and I had the most success with that archetype.

subject: Very hard strategy
text: On very hard, start by spamming three-pointers to secure a two-possession lead, then focus on dunks with Larry Johnson.

evidence.quote: I started off spamming 3 pointers trying to secure a two possession lead. After that I would focus on dunks with Larry Johnson.

subject: V. Hard bots
text: On very hard the bots pass the ball much more, so spamming steals from baseline inbounds can be used to your advantage.

evidence.quote: The very hard mode bots pass the ball much more than the other difficulties. We can use this to our advantage by trying to spam steals out of the baseline inbounds.

subject: Steal
text: Running in front of the passing lane while holding turbo can steal the ball.

evidence.quote: Some of the time just running in front of the passing lane while holding turbo is enough to steal the ball.

subject: Steal
text: A steal right under the basket allows an immediate dunk.

evidence.quote: Since the ball is stolen right under the basket we can go up for an immediate dunk.

subject: Teammate jump pass
text: Involving your teammate with a jump pass can get you out of double teams for an easy roll to the basket.

evidence.quote: This can get you out of double teams and you find an easy roll to the basket.

subject: Legendary Team
text: One player reported the Legendary Team achievement popped up early and submitted a ticket.

evidence.quote: I did have the achievement "Legendary Team" pop up prematurely and submitted a ticket.
